## Agent workpad

### GH-25 audit verdict: blocked; coordinator repair split required

Audited current main/head `71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362` on 2026-10-09. Issue was open/ready, parent active, and the fresh-origin/main manifest/ledger validator passed. Sole registered dependency #217 is closed completed: [PR #267](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/pull/267), [merge](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/commit/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362), [exact-main CI](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/actions/runs/37996690481), independent review and acceptance in [completion workpad](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/issues/217#issuecomment-6082444182). Children #214/#215/#216 also closed completed. No child implementation is being redelivered.

**Blocking evidence (source-contract audit, not a newly executed behavioral-red test):**

1. RFC B021 defines counters as worker-local counts **and sampled timing histograms**. [metrics.rs lines 274–300](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/crates/mtg-core/src/metrics.rs#L274) always exports `sampled_timing: "not_measured"`; no histogram implementation exists there. [Delivered documentation](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/doc/scalar-metrics.md) explicitly says “These modes add no timing histograms”. Benchmark aggregate phase totals/window distributions do not implement sampled decision/boundary latency histograms. This remains an applicable scalar §6 requirement, unlike deferred worker/batch/inference metrics.
2. B021 requires testing semantic equivalence across modes **and measuring their overhead separately**. [benchmark.rs lines 32–42](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/crates/mtg-cli/src/benchmark.rs#L32) admits only off/counters for BOTH scalar-windows-v1 and scalar-full-pool-v1. Its [normal-discovery contract test](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/crates/mtg-cli/src/benchmark.rs#L563) explicitly requires sampled_trace/full_replay rejection. The [collector](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/scripts/collect_scalar_baseline.py) and [published campaign](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/doc/evidence/full-pool-baseline/README.md) measure only off/counters. Existing four-mode semantic tests do not supply missing trace/replay overhead measurements.

These are missing implementation/measurement contracts, not a failed provisional speed target and not merely missing hardware access. Expanding telemetry, frozen benchmark versions and the campaign together exceeds this bounded integration/evidence audit. No requirement, test or production validation was weakened.

### Original acceptance / clause crosswalk

| Original obligation | Existing exact-main evidence and audit disposition |
| --- | --- |
| B008: distinguish valid games/s, decisions and completed logical actions; capacity versus throughput | [Raw full-pool reports](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/doc/evidence/full-pool-baseline/throughput/collection.json), [benchmark contract](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/doc/evidence/scalar-benchmark/README.md), [resident curves](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/doc/evidence/full-pool-baseline/resident/summary.json). Physical core allocation unavailable, so no qualified physical-core/host claim. Native latency histograms remain part of repair 1. End-to-end learner/queue/host scaling deferred by current program. |
| B014: correctness-gated scalar baseline; allocation and boundary costs; no invented Rust/Python comparison | [Baseline/oracle/profiles](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/doc/evidence/full-pool-baseline/README.md) pin measured e64842e executable and source, preserve full torture and repair prerequisite receipts. No optimization, language comparison, unsafe rewrite or second engine. Integration after measurement changes tests/evidence only; do not relabel historical binary as freshly measured. |
| B019: scalar, resident and counters hypotheses; truthful misses and actual games/s | Both policies miss 100k decisions/s; observed counters reductions 15.66% heuristic, 1.53% legal-random. Four classes reach 10,000 copied resident states, first-cycle 4.79–7.09 KiB/state with retention caveats. ARM64/four-logical-CPU/7-GiB limits explicit, not designated-host qualification. Eight-core/Python/interactive hypotheses deferred. Target misses are not this blocker. |
| B020 tracks: transition/legality, native rollout, encoding, capacity | Existing native boundaries, CPU/heap profiles, all eight matchup rows, both policies, typical/token/target/stack stress and reset churn documented in baseline. Encoding API has injected-clock coverage; published throughput has optional extra encoding OFF, so no independently measured encoded-track result is claimed. Fixed-trace application versus legal-generation microcosts/effect-dispatch detail must be explicitly accounted in repair 2, not inferred from combined transition totals. |
| B020 tracks: Python/native batches, inference, worker/batch sweep, CLI | Later ownership is explicit in [atomic plan](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/doc/programs/m2-atomic-delivery.md#L418), and engine-validation amendment defers these paths. No zero, acceptance or new RL work inferred. |
| B020 workload pins, warmup/windows, variance, denominator/outcomes | Versioned workload/decks/action/policies/seeds, compiler/binary/OS/affinity receipts; 10s warmups and all 30 measurement windows retained including slower extension. Five receipt-bearing artifacts freshly validate. 3,126 natural completions, 29 unfinished, one pre-reset attempt, no failed/truncated measured games. No shortened horizon or omitted intervals. |
| B020 allocation/legal/encoding/effect/cache/synchronization/dominant costs | Independent heap counts/bytes and CPU profiles expose SHA-256/JSON/allocation costs; native phase totals include policy separately. Hardware/cache facilities unavailable and synchronization not qualified. Preserve explicit limitations; no leak-free/allocation-free/designated-host claims. Missing scalar timing and mode measurements are not excused by those limits. |
| B021 four explicit modes; local aggregation/export | [Scalar metrics guide](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/doc/scalar-metrics.md), [metrics implementation](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/crates/mtg-core/src/metrics.rs), [native boundary](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/crates/mtg-cli/src/native.rs): four modes exist, fixed counters merge locally and export versioned summaries; no shared atomic per rule operation. Sampled timing missing: BLOCKED. |
| B021 every required metric | Started/completed/truncated/failed; accepted decisions by bounded kind, logical actions, work units, resets, capacity/invalid/stale/exception counters and diagnostic drops exist. Policy and encoding phase timing and OS high-water exist in benchmark/collector scope; ordinary metrics explicitly report not_measured. Worker busy/idle, ready queues, batch fill and inference are genuinely unimplemented/deferred paths, marked not_applicable rather than zero. Sampled timing is missing on the implemented scalar path. |
| B021 bounded labels/privacy | [metrics tests](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/crates/mtg-core/tests/metrics.rs) contain hand-counted outcomes, hidden sentinels, saturating merges, invalid/stale and clock/recording errors. Labels carry no game/seed/card/error strings. Privileged replay remains separate from public diagnostics. Existing delivered evidence, no fresh Rust execution claimed. |
| B021 buffers, drops, replay completeness/backpressure | [trace tests](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/crates/mtg-core/tests/trace_modes.rs), [trace evidence](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/71776215b7c2372757b37c4113ac1c0a28bb1362/doc/evidence/trace-modes/README.md): literal selected decisions 2/4 and one drop at capacity one, zero-capacity drops, bounds, reset, replay overflow/incomplete rejection and canonical write failure tests. Replay size bounds returned bytes, not serialization peak memory; limitation stays explicit. |
| B021 versioned artifacts, exceptional paths, four-mode semantic equality | Delivered normal-discovery metrics/trace/native/capture tests cover equivalent state/RNG/records, quanta, reset/rejection and capture independence. Their historical full-suite receipts remain valid for their exact heads; this audit does not claim a fresh full suite. Four-mode overhead: BLOCKED by the benchmark contract. |
| B021 independent trajectories and separately measured storage cost | Off does not disable requested existing canonical capture; persistence/failure tests retained. SYS-PERF-004 storage/Python/sharded qualification belongs to later owners, not silently counted as measured scalar instrumentation. |

Stable test ownership: SYS-METRIC-001 is incomplete for sampled timing; SYS-METRIC-002 retains bounded-label and measured off/counters evidence, without a blanket ≤5% claim. SYS-PERF-001 retains scalar profile limitations and the additional measurements below; SYS-PERF-002/003 retain available-container distributions/capacity evidence, not deferred host qualification.

### Concrete coordinator split (proposal only; no task/manifest edits)

1. **Scalar sampled timing and bounded latency summaries.** Add optional boundary-owned sampled histograms with fixed buckets/cardinality, explicit availability and local aggregation. No clock in game rules, no extra RNG use, no per-small-rule-operation clock. Cover exact injected-clock counts/buckets, sampling/reset/merge/overflow, policy/encoding separation, off absent, privacy and four-mode/capture semantics before implementation. Retain outcome/error tests. Depend on #214/#215/#216. Acceptance links B008 latency/B021 counters and SYS-METRIC-001/002.
2. **Versioned scalar mode/profile completion campaign.** After repair 1, add a NEW frozen benchmark contract for all four modes (retain historical v1 rejection tests), stating trace selection/capacity, replay completeness and whether persistence is timed. Test comparable configuration and full denominator/outcome/error accounting before implementation. Freeze normal full-pool eight-row heuristic/random workload, retain horizons, use 10s + ≥5×30s windows with declared variance extension; publish all four-mode overhead and semantic receipts. Include an encoded scalar measurement and explicit fixed validated trace/application/legal-action/effect-dispatch cost accounting, retaining allocation/memory and unsupported hardware/cache/synchronization limits. No batch/Python/RL, optimization, CLI or designated-host expansion. Depend on repair 1 and #217; independent review must approve any new version's changed expectations without weakening historical tests.

Coordinator registration/dependency review and explicit reactivation are required before this audit resumes; feature worker has not added tasks or altered authorization. #25/#26 retain every original requirement.

### Checks, README, and delivery status

Fresh main graph/ledger validation PASS. Fresh `scripts/scalar_artifact.py` validation PASS for heuristic-off, heuristic-counters, heuristic-counters-extended, legal-random-off and legal-random-counters. This validates existing evidence, not a newly measured run. No production/test/README edits, PR, commit, new behavioral implementation, fresh torture or separate delivery review: there is no implementation candidate to integrate. Existing README already describes bounded modes/measurement limits and keeps M2 incomplete; no usable behavior/setup/status changed, so no README change is needed for this blocked audit.

Approximately 15 minutes elapsed. Next: unsuccessful bounded handoff under shared lock, preserving #23/#212 claims and never satisfying #26's dependency. Then keep issue open, add agent-blocked, remove running and ready last. No completion claimed.


Final unsuccessful handoff confirmed under the existing shared lock: freshly fetched main unchanged; all 129 manifest task states checked, no eligible independent unclaimed successor. #24 still depends on unfinished #23/#212; #26 cannot use failed #25 as completion. Existing #23/#212 ready/running claims and all parent evidence retained. Parent workpad now records this blocker and proposed coordinator split. No successor activated; no task/requirement/gate was changed. Issue remains open and is now deliberately blocked pending coordinator registration and explicit reactivation.
